integrity: An explicit analytic proof accompanies numerical checks. Numerical sampling does not certify infinite quantifiers. The source theorems concerning invariant-diagonal attraction and off-diagonal convergence are credited to the originating authors.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to the symmetric two-player map with a>8, fixed small exit thresholds, nonexceptional interior diagonal starts, and a high-gain limit of fixed-gain escape coefficients. No assertion about uniform joint gain/perturbation limits or times to equilibria. Research priority cannot be guaranteed for unindexed literature.
title: Universal near-symmetry escape clock in a two-player multiplicative-weights map
